text.p: Greek construction firm Proodeftiki will seek shareholder approval for a three-for-10 bonus issue at its forthcoming annual general assembly, it said in a statement.
Proodeftiki intends to capitalise reserves totalling 1.679 billion drachmas, issuing three bonus shares per 10 outstanding and raising share par value by 131 drachmas to 285.
It said it would distribute a dividend per share of 70 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 50 a year earlier.
Pretax earnings rose 15.9 percent to 1.512 billion drachmas in 1996 on turnover growth of 22.5 percent to 7.912 billion.
Revenues realised from projects carried out by Proodeftiki as a single contractor and in joint ventures was split 60:40, unchanged from 1995, it said.
The uncompleted portion of its orderbook currently stands at 38.7 billion drachmas.
Proodeftiki's shares firmed 30 drachmas to 1,850 on Monday on volume of 11,780 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
